draft.emotion: a mix of admiration and a small pinch of bitterness, sighing softly
notes: Irregular ㅂ adjective: ㅂ changes to 우 before a vowel (부러워요, 부러운).
The person or thing you envy takes the subject particle 이/가 (친구가 부러워요, 'I envy my friend'). Unlike English 'jealous', it is commonly used as a polite compliment ('I'm so jealous!').
